display_long_description:
# Introducing AR-Toolkit!

Experience a new dimension of measurement with AR-Toolkit, an augmented reality application designed to measure distances, angles, curves, and areas in real-time 3D space. Leveraging cutting-edge VR tools attached to body sockets, AR-Toolkit brings unparalleled convenience and precision directly into your hands.

# Key Features:
- **3D Precision:** Effortlessly measure distances, angles, curves, and surface areas with pinpoint accuracy in an immersive 3D environment.
- **Intuitive Interaction:** VR tools attach for fluid, natural movement. Simply pick up the tools within the virtual space and start measuring without cumbersome hardware setups.


- **Versitile Use Cases:** From interior design and architecture to educational demonstrations and creative prototyping, AR-Toolkit adapts to a wide variety of professional and personal projects.
- **Real-Time Visualization:** See your measurements update instantly in augmented reality. Make quick adjustments to angles and layouts with confidence.
- **User-Friendly Interface:** A clean and intuitive interface keeps the learning curve low, enabling anyone—from hobbyists to professionals—to get started immediately.
